items.text: In the Advisor Services arena, Schwab states it competes with institutional custodians, wirehouses, regional and independent broker-dealers, fintech custodians, banks, and trust companies.
items.quote: In the Advisor Services arena, we compete with institutional custodians, wirehouses, regional and independent broker-dealers, fintech custodians, banks, and trust companies.

items.text: Schwab names Fidelity Investments as a close rival and the second-largest RIA custodian after Schwab.
items.quote: Schwab's close rival, Fidelity , offers up to 1.94% on sweep cash, and 3.49% through its money market funds.

items.text: Schwab's trade press notes Fidelity Investments is the second-largest custodian after Schwab, and that Schwab will continue to focus on custody for RIAs under $100M AUM after Fidelity told such firms to leave.
items.quote: Wurster's comments come after Fidelity Investments, the second-largest custodian after Schwab, told RIAs in early October that firms with under $100 million in client assets will have to leave the platform by June 30, 2027.

items.text: Altruist, described as now Vanguard-owned custodian, is named as a competitor offering a high-yield cash account.
items.quote: The now Vanguard-owned custodian, Altruist, offers 0.05% in sweep accounts, and a maximum 3.75% through a high-yield cash account.

items.text: Vanguard (through its acquisition of Altruist) is named as a competitor setting up to compete with Fidelity and Schwab in RIA custody.
items.quote: this clearly sets them up to compete with Fidelity for sure, and arguably it sets them up competitively with Schwab.

items.text: Schwab Advisor Network is described as competing alongside Fidelity's Wealth Advisor Solutions (WAS) as the biggest custodian client referral programs for RIAs.
items.quote: Schwab Advisor Network has been running since 2002, competing alongside Fidelity's Wealth Advisor Solutions (WAS) as the biggest custodian client referral programs for RIAs.

items.text: Goldman Sachs and TradePMR by Robinhood are named as custodians that have debuted referral programs as alternatives to Schwab Advisor Network.
items.quote: Custodians such as Goldman Sachs and TradePMR by Robinhood have also debuted referral programs over the past year as added alternatives to Schwab Advisor Network.

items.text: SEI, Goldman, and Robinhood are named by a recruiter as other custodians RIAs may look to after Schwab's referral changes.
items.quote: Do they start looking at SEI ? Do they start looking at Goldman? Do they start looking at the lead flow through Robinhood ?

items.text: BNY Pershing is named as a custodian alongside Schwab for a breakaway advisory firm.
items.quote: an advisory duo who managed about $18.6 billion in client assets at J.P. Morgan Advisors launched Latigo Peak Partners with custodians Schwab and BNY Pershing.
